Termination due to abandonment

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

{# Fetch Employee and Reminder Data safely #} {% set employee_doc = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.employee_id, ["date_of_joining"], as_dict=True) if doc.employee_id else None %} {% set reminder_doc = frappe.db.get_value("Reminder Of Unauthorized Absence", {"case_id": doc.case_id}, ["date_of_1st_letter", "date_of_reminder_letter"], as_dict=True) if doc.case_id else None %}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name or "" }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id or "" }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation or "" }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name or "" }}

Zone Name: {{ doc.zone_name or "" }}

Whereas, you were appointed by Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society as per the terms and conditions of employment specifically provided in the Offer / Appointment Letter dated {% if employee_doc and employee_doc.date_of_joining %} {{ frappe.utils.format_date(employee_doc.date_of_joining, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} {% else %} [Date Missing] {% endif %}.

{% if reminder_doc and reminder_doc.date_of_1st_letter %}

That vide this Company’s letter dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(reminder_doc.date_of_1st_letter, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, a show cause notice was served to you seeking explanation for your unauthorized absence since {{ frappe.utils.format_date(reminder_doc.date_of_1st_letter, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, {% if reminder_doc.date_of_reminder_letter %} followed by reminder dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(reminder_doc.date_of_reminder_letter, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}. {% endif %} You were also suggested to resume office immediately after receipt of the said notice. But till date, neither you resumed office nor any reply was received from your end.

{% else %}

That despite our previous communications and notices regarding your unauthorized absence, you have neither reported for duty nor provided any explanation for your absence till date.

{% endif %}

Please be advised that the above-mentioned act of yours amounts to serious misconduct within the meaning of Human Resource Policies of the Company applicable to you. You are deemed to have abandoned duties/employment of your own accord and the Company presumes that you are no longer interested in the employment.

As a result, the Company has decided against the continuation of your services and accordingly, your services are terminated hereby with immediate effect.

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Cooperative Society
name: Termination due to abandonment
